runtime_dependencies: Python standard library only; all input data co-located
scope: Tree shape may change. No global one-color or graceful-tree existence claim; no historical novelty assertion.

sources.binary_controls: independent reviewer enumeration of 80 binary matroids
sources.graphic_controls: deterministic constructive algorithm with explicit per-move checks

theorem: All integer-difference upper-tail completion fibers are connected by at-most-two-color moves; diameter at most 2^(r-1) for r>=1, and zero for r=0.
